Class SortingWFSDataStoreFactory

java.lang.Object
org.geotools.data.wfs.impl.WFSDataAccessFactory
org.geotools.data.wfs.WFSDataStoreFactory
org.tailormap.api.geotools.wfs.SortingWFSDataStoreFactory
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.geotools.api.data.DataAccessFactory, org.geotools.api.data.DataStoreFactorySpi, org.geotools.util.factory.Factory
public class SortingWFSDataStoreFactory extends org.geotools.data.wfs.WFSDataStoreFactory
WFSDataStoreFactory that creates a WFSDataStore with a SortingWFSClient. This is a copy of WFSDataStoreFactory.createDataStore(Map) (GeoTools 35.2) with only the client class changed, because the client is created inline there.

This is not registered as a DataStoreFactorySpi, use it directly. It can be removed when GeoTools supports sorting for WFS 2.0.0 itself.
